subject: General Studies
question: Jaydev Unadkat emerged as the most expensive Indian Player in 2018 IPL auction. He is signed by ________.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. At the January 2018 IPL auction Jaydev Unadkat went to Rajasthan Royals for ₹12.5 crore — the costliest Indian pick that year. Kings XI Punjab, CSK, and KKR bid for other stars but not this left-arm pacer at that price.

subject: General Studies
question: Who among the following is the recipient of the award for research on language in the name of Dr. Ashok Kelkar, given by the government of Maharashtra ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Dr Avinash Biniwale received Maharashtra's Dr Ashok Kelkar award for language research — the state honour named after the linguist Kelkar. Pathare, Joshi, and Kamat are Marathi scholars linked to other institutions, not the recipient named in the answer key.

subject: General Studies
question: Who is the author of the book 'The Coalition Years' ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. 'The Coalition Years' is the second volume of Pranab Mukherjee's memoir series on his decades in Delhi's power corridors. Chidambaram, Manmohan Singh, and Kapil Sibal have written on economics and politics, but this title belongs to Mukherjee.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements about the 'Pradhan Mantri Matritva (Matru) Vandana Yojana' : (a) This scheme was launched by the Central Government on April 1, 2016. (b) Under the Scheme government would provide ₹ 8,000 financial aid to pregnant and lactating mothers. (c) It also aims at improving the health of pregnant women and lactating mothers through cash incentives.
explanation: The right pick is option D. Only statement (c) holds — PMMVY uses cash incentives so pregnant and lactating mothers get better nutrition and antenatal care. Statement (a) is wrong about the launch date (2017, not 1 April 2016), and (b) overstates the benefit at ₹8,000 when the scheme pays ₹5,000 in instalments.

subject: General Studies
question: Following are the different initiatives by Tourism Ministry, Government of India. Which of them is incorrectly stated ?

options.A: PRASAD - free food distribution to visitors at renowned pilgrimage sites.
options.B: HRIDAY - preserve, revitalized India's heritage cities.
options.C: Incredible India 2.0 - to promote tourism in India.
options.D: e - ticketing at Tourist sites - started at Taj mahal and Humayun Tomb.

explanation: On this one, option A. PRASAD stands for Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive — infrastructure and amenities at pilgrimage sites, not free food distribution. HRIDAY, Incredible India 2.0, and e-ticketing at the Taj and Humayun's Tomb are stated correctly in the other options.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statements about Kailash Mansarovar Yatra are true ? (a) It has been organised by Ministry of External Affairs. (b) It has been organised through two different routes Lipulekh Pass (Uttarakhand) and Nathula Pass (Sikkim). (c) Foreign Nationals are not eligible to apply for this yatra. (d) Ministry of External Affairs does not provide any subsidy/financial assistance to Yatris.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. MEA organises Kailash Mansarovar Yatra via Lipulekh (Uttarakhand) and Nathula (Sikkim); only Indian citizens may apply; and the ministry gives no subsidy — yatris bear the cost. All four statements (a)–(d) match the official scheme rules.

subject: General Studies
question: '#MeToo' campaign on social media is related with __________.
explanation: Pick option A. The #MeToo hashtag spread stories of sexual harassment and assault — especially in workplaces and media — after allegations surfaced in Hollywood in 2017. Depression, privacy, and voter campaigns are separate social-media causes with different hashtags.

subject: General Studies
question: What is the range of Agni - 5 ballistic missile ?
explanation: Go with option A. Agni-V is India's long-range surface-to-surface ballistic missile tested for roughly 5,000–5,500 km — enough to reach targets across Asia. The 3,500 km figure fits earlier Agni variants; 7,500 km and 10,000 km overshoot what DRDO publicly claimed for Agni-V in this period.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following : Village/City - Project (a) Pawani Tahsil - (i) Nagzira Tiger Project (b) Chichpalli - (ii) Gosikhurd (c) Navegaon - (iii) Mazi Metro (d) Nagpur - (iv) Bamboo Research and Training Centre
explanation: The right pick is option A. Lock the Maharashtra map: Pawani tahsil → Gosikhurd (ii); Chichpalli → Bamboo Research and Training Centre (iv); Navegaon belt → Nagzira Tiger Project (i); Nagpur city → Mazi Metro (iii). Swapping Nagzira with Gosikhurd or metro with bamboo centre breaks the locality pairing.

subject: Polity
question: The main function of Maharashtra State Commission for women is __________ (a) To evaluate the progress of the women empowerment in the state (b) To implement the Directive Principles of the Constitution mentioned in the article 38, 39, 39-A and 42 (c) To conduct the elections of the women for the state legislative assembly as well as local self Government (d) None of the above
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The Maharashtra State Commission for Women monitors women's empowerment progress and works toward Directive Principles in Articles 38, 39, 39-A, and 42. It does not conduct assembly or local-body elections — that role belongs to the Election Commission.

subject: Economy
question: Which Yojana has been launched by central government for providing Physical Aids and Assisted - living Devices to Senior Citizens belonging to below poverty line category?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (February 2016) gives physical aids and assisted-living devices to BPL senior citizens with age-related disabilities. The 'Deen Dayal', 'Pradhanmantri', and 'Atal' prefixes in the distractors are not the official scheme name.

subject: General Studies
question: Avani Chaturvedi has become the first Indian woman to fly a fighter jet solo. Which aircraft did she fly ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Flying Officer Avani Chaturvedi completed a solo sortie on the MiG-21 Bison in February 2018 — the first Indian woman on a fighter jet. MiG-27, Sukhoi, and Su-57 are other IAF platforms she did not fly on that milestone mission.

subject: General Studies
question: Which state has launched KCR Kit Scheme for the welfare of pregnant women and new born babies in the states?
explanation: Go with option A. Telangana's KCR Kit Scheme — named after Chief Minister K Chandrashekar Rao — supports pregnant women and newborns with financial aid and essential supplies. Kerala, Haryana, and Assam run their own maternal-welfare programmes under different names.

subject: General Studies
question: According to a report by 'New world wealth', Mumbai is among the top 15 richest cities in the world. Which city follows Mumbai in this report?
explanation: On this one, option B. The New World Wealth 2018 city ranking placed Mumbai among the world's top 15 richest cities, with Toronto ranked immediately after it in that list. Chicago, Frankfurt, and Shanghai sit elsewhere in global wealth tables — follow the Toronto pairing given in the answer key.

subject: Polity
question: According to Maharashtra Zilla Parishad and Panchayat Samiti Act, 1961. Match the following pairs : Subject - Article (a) Various Committees and Structure in Zilla Parishad - (i) Article - 95 (b) Appointment of Block Development Officer - (ii) Article - 78 (c) Powers and Functions of Panchayat Samiti President and Vice President - (iii) Article - 97 (d) Powers and Functions of Chief Executive Officers - (iv) Article - 76
explanation: Pick option B. The official answer key gives the sequence (ii), (iii), (iv), (i) for (a)–(d). Textbook tables often pair Art. 95 with ZP committees, Art. 78 with the BDO, Art. 97 with the Panchayat Samiti President/VP, and Art. 76 with the CEO — a different order than option B; follow the official answer for this paper.

subject: General Studies
question: Human Rights activist, Asma Jehangir recently Passed away, she was a citizen of ______.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Asma Jahangir was a leading Pakistani human rights lawyer and activist who passed away in February 2018. She fought for democracy and women's rights in Pakistan — not India, Bangladesh, or Afghanistan.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following subjects are included in the concurrent list ? (a) Electricity (b) Marriage and Divorce, adoption (c) Weights and measures and establishment of its standards (d) Trade Union
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Electricity, marriage/divorce/adoption, and trade unions sit on the Concurrent List — both Parliament and states may legislate. Weights and measures with 'establishment of standards' are framed as a Union subject in standard lists, so statement (c) is not in this keyed set.

subject: General Studies
question: Find out the incorrect statements : (a) National Commission for Backward Classes is statutory body. (b) It works under Home Ministry. (c) NCBC is not yet been empowered to look into the grievances of persons of other Backward classes. (d) It was established in year 1990.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. NCBC is a statutory body under the Ministry of Social Justice, not Home; it can look into OBC grievances; and it was set up in 1993, not 1990. Statements (b) and (d) alone are wrong — ministry and year are the traps.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements : (with reference to High Court) (a) The President has the power to appoint an additional judge for a temporary period of not exceeding two years for the clearance of the arrears of the work in a High Court. (b) The President can appoint an acting judge when a permanent judge of the High Court (other than a Chief Justice) is temporarily absent or unable to perform his duties. (c) Neither an additional nor acting judge can hold office beyond the age of 65 years. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. The President may appoint additional judges (up to two years) to clear arrears and acting judges when a permanent judge is absent — both under Article 224. Statement (c) fails because High Court judges retire at 62, not 65 (that age applies to Supreme Court judges).

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs of Adult Franchise obtained countries: Country - Year (a) Sri Lanka - (i) 1962 (b) Malaysia - (ii) 1994 (c) Australia - (iii) 1931 (d) South Africa - (iv) 1955
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Match adult-franchise milestones: Sri Lanka 1931 (iii), Malaysia 1955 (iv), Australia 1962 (i) for Aboriginal federal voting rights, South Africa 1994 (ii) post-apartheid. The (iii), (iv), (i), (ii) order is the chronology given in the answer key.

subject: Polity
question: The state can impose reasonable restrictions on the freedom of speech and expression [Article - 19 (1)(a)] on which of the following grounds ? (a) Contempt of court (b) Protection of minorities (c) Friendly relations with foreign states (d) Sovereignty and integrity of India (e) Decency or morality
explanation: On this one, option C. Article 19(2) permits reasonable restrictions for contempt of court, friendly relations with foreign states, sovereignty and integrity of India, and decency or morality. 'Protection of minorities' is not listed among the Article 19(2) grounds — that is the statement to drop.

subject: General Studies
question: Which one of the following statements regarding Maharashtra Legislature is incorrect?

options.A: A bill pending in the legislature is not lapsed by reason of prorogation of the houses.
options.B: A bill pending in the Legislative council which has not been passed by the Legislative Assembly is not lapsed on a dissolution of the Assembly.
options.C: A bill pending in the Legislative Assembly or which, having been passed by the Legislative Assembly is pending in the council is lapsed on a dissolution of the Assembly.

explanation: Go with option D. All three statements match Article 196 on bill lapse in Maharashtra: prorogation alone does not kill a pending bill; a Council-only bill survives Assembly dissolution; and an Assembly bill lapses on dissolution. None of A, B, or C is incorrect — so 'None of these' fits.

subject: Polity
question: Find the incorrectly matched pair/s : Article - Provision (a) 343 - Official language of the Union (b) 345 - Language to be used in Supreme Court and High Court and for Acts, Bills etc. (c) 348 - Official language/languages of a state (d) 351 - Directive for development of the Hindi language
explanation: Pick option B. Articles 343 and 351 are matched correctly — Union official language and Hindi development. Articles 345 and 348 are swapped in (b) and (c): Art. 345 covers state legislature languages; Art. 348 covers language in the Supreme Court, High Courts, and for Acts and Bills.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements regarding the Metropolitan Planning Committee : (a) The composition and the manner of election of members of such committees are decided by State Government. (b) The State Government may make provision about the representation in such committees of the Central Government, State Government and other organisations. Which of the above statements is/are incorrect ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The answer key treats both statements as correct under Article 243ZE — state-level rules on MPC composition and room for Central, state, and other organisations on the committee. Standard notes sometimes say 'State Legislature' rather than 'State Government' in (a); here neither statement is flagged wrong.

subject: History
question: Arrange the following in chronological order : (a) IInd Round Table Conference (b) Nehru Report (c) Gandhi - Irwin Pact (d) Communal Award
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Nehru Report came first (1928), then the Gandhi–Irwin Pact (1931), the Second Round Table Conference (September 1931), and finally the Communal Award (1932). That timeline — (b), (c), (a), (d) — is what the answer key expects.

subject: General Studies
question: In which of the following states, seats are reserved for Scheduled Tribes in the Lok Sabha ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Odisha has Scheduled Tribe reserved constituencies in the Lok Sabha — tribal belts like Koraput and Nabarangpur. After Jharkhand's creation Bihar lost ST seats; Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh carry no ST reservation in the lower house.

subject: History
question: The Holkars were neutral during the Revolt of 1857, yet their soldiers revolted at which of the following places ? (a) Bhopal (b) Mahu (c) Indore (d) Mahidasi
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Though the Holkar ruler stayed neutral in 1857, sepoys under Holkar command rose at Mahu and Indore. Bhopal and Mahidasi are distractors from other Malwa episodes.

subject: Geography
question: The farmers from which district of Bengal had established an organization of Farmers in 1873 ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Pabna district ryots organised against zamindari oppression in 1873 — one of Bengal's early peasant movements. Rajmahal, Murshidabad, and Bhagalpur are other Bengal districts but not this association.

subject: General Studies
question: In 1920 A.D. __________ was appointed as the first High Commissioner of India.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Sir William Meyer took office as India's first High Commissioner in London in 1920, representing the Government of India after the Montagu–Chelmsford reforms. Montagu and Chelmsford framed policy; Meyer held the post.

subject: History
question: Who had started the following periodicals ? (a) Vidyarthi (b) Congress (c) Sadhana
explanation: Go with option D. Pandit Sane Guruji edited and ran the periodicals Vidyarthi, Congress, and Sadhana as part of his nationalist and social-reform journalism in Maharashtra. Atre, Tirth, and Hirve Guruji are linked to other publications.

subject: Reasoning
question: Operation Polo was undertaken to merge which of the following states in Indian Union ?
explanation: On this one, option B. Operation Polo (September 1948) was the military action to integrate Hyderabad (Deccan) into the Indian Union. Junagadh and Kashmir had separate accession episodes; Limdi is a distractor.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following : a. Kichakvadh - (i) Ganesh Ballal Fansalkar b. Swadeshi - (ii) Vasudeo Purushottam Sathe c. Vang Bhang - (iii) Krishnaji Prabhakar Khadilkar d. Bhimrao - (iv) Laxman Narayan Joshi
explanation: Pick option A. Kichakvadh is Khadilkar's play; Swadeshi by Ganesh Ballal Fansalkar; Vang Bhang by V. P. Sathe; Bhimrao by Laxman Narayan Joshi — a-(iii), b-(i), c-(ii), d-(iv). Khadilkar's dramatic output is the anchor pair here.

subject: General Studies
question: The Kolhapur Praja Parishad was established by the efforts of __________ and __________.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Madhavrao Bagal and Ratnappa Kumbhar led the formation of the Kolhapur Praja Parishad, pressing democratic rights under the princely state. The other name-pairs belong to different Kolhapur movements.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following honours were Conferred on Maharshi Dhondo Keshav Karve ? (a) Bharat Ratna (b) Padma Vibhushan (c) D. Litt. (d) LL. D.
explanation: The right pick is option D. Maharshi Dhondo Keshav Karve received Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, honorary D.Litt., and LL.D. degrees for his lifelong work on women's education and social reform — all four honours in the stem apply.

subject: History
question: Krishnaji Prabhakar Khadilkar became a follower of __________.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Krishnaji Prabhakar Khadilkar moved from Tilak-era militant journalism toward Gandhian non-violence and became a close follower of M. K. Gandhi. Gokhale and Deshmukh represent earlier liberal streams.

subject: General Studies
question: The discussion between Vishnubaba Brahmachari and the Missionaries is found in the book __________.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The debate between Vishnubaba Brahmachari and Christian missionaries is recorded in 'Samudra Kinaricha Vad Vivad'. The other titles are different Marathi reform or religious works.

subject: Polity
question: Yomeshchandra Banarjee, the first President of the National Congress stated the objectives for the establishment of the National Congress, which were they ? (a) Social Equality/Uniformity (b) National Feeling (c) Secularism (d) Development of sense of unity and consolidation of the same
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee, the first INC president, stressed fostering national feeling and a sense of Indian unity — statements (b) and (d). Social equality and secularism were not framed as his founding objectives in the syllabus note this paper follows.

subject: General Studies
question: By which law was the Supreme Court of Calcutta established ?
explanation: On this one, option A. The Regulating Act of 1773 established the Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta — India's first chartered high court under Company rule. Pitt's India Act (1784) reformed governance but did not create that court.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following pairs is correct ?

options.B: S. Gopal - Emergency of Indian Nationalism
options.C: Anil Seal - Problems and Politics of British in India 1885 - 89
options.D: Hiralal Sinha - British Policy in India

explanation: Go with option A. Tapan Raychaudhuri (Bagchi) authored 'Private Investment in India 1900–1939' — the correctly matched author–work pair. The other options transpose well-known historians onto wrong book titles.

subject: General Studies
question: Who wrote the Booklet "Bandi Jiven" ?
explanation: Pick option D. Sachindranath Sanyal wrote the revolutionary booklet 'Bandi Jivan' ('Prison Life') from cellular confinement. Azad, Bose, and Bismil authored other tracts in the same era but not this title.

subject: General Studies
question: ________ is major port of Gujarat State.
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Kandla (Deendayal Port) on the Gulf of Kutch is one of Gujarat's major ports. Kochi is in Kerala; Mandvi is a smaller Kutch harbour, not listed as the major port in this framing.

subject: General Studies
question: What is total Geographical area of Maharashtra ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Maharashtra's total geographical area is about 307.70 lakh hectares in the state statistical handbook the paper cites — roughly 3.07 lakh sq km converted to hectares. The lower options understate the state's size.

subject: General Studies
question: Because of Kokan Railway the distance between Mumbai to Kochin is reduced by ______ km.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The Konkan Railway shortened the rail distance between Mumbai and Kochi by about 513 km by cutting through the Western Ghats instead of the longer inland route via Chennai.

subject: General Studies
question: ________ is recorded in world heritage site.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Ajanta caves are inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List for their Buddhist rock-cut art. Karle, Pitalkhora, and Bedsa are important Deccan caves but not the keyed heritage entry here.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following river is not a part of Godavari basin ?
explanation: The right pick is option D. Terna, Pravara, and Manjra are Godavari tributaries in Maharashtra; Bhatsa belongs to the Ulhas basin on the Konkan side and is not part of the Godavari drainage system.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following states has high tank irrigation ?
explanation: On this one, option A. Andhra Pradesh (especially Telangana region) leads India in tank-irrigation area — thousands of village tanks on the Deccan plateau. Maharashtra relies more on wells and canals; MP and Gujarat rank lower on this metric.

subject: Geography
question: Gomit, Pardhi, Bhill these Scheduled tribes are mainly found in which of the following district ?
explanation: Go with option C. Gond (Gomit), Pardhi, and Bhil communities are concentrated in Dhule and the adjacent north-Maharashtra tribal belt. Akola, Buldhana, and Thane host other tribal groups in the state map.

subject: Economy
question: Indias First Five Year Plan __________.
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. India's First Five Year Plan ran from 1951 to 1956, launched after the Planning Commission was set up in 1950. The 1950–55 and 1941–46 bands are common date traps in planning chronology.

subject: Geography
question: As per census 2011 __________ district has highest population of schedule cast in Maharashtra.
explanation: Pick option C. Census 2011 placed Pune district at the top for Scheduled Caste population in Maharashtra in absolute numbers — driven by the Pune–Pimpri industrial belt and long-standing migration. Nashik, Aurangabad, and Solapur trail on this count.

subject: Geography
question: What is the main water divider of Maharashtra ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The Sahyadri (Western Ghats) range is Maharashtra's main water divide — rivers to the west drain into the Arabian Sea, and east-flowing streams feed the Deccan river systems. Satpuda, Nilgiri, and Aravali lie outside this core divide.

subject: General Studies
question: The first nuclear reactor in Maharashtra is known as _____________.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Apsara, commissioned in 1956 at BARC Trombay, was India's first nuclear reactor — and it sits in Maharashtra. Cyrus, Dhruva and Purnima are also BARC units, but Apsara holds the 'first' tag this paper expects.

subject: Geography
question: ________ is the first Tourism district in Maharashtra.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Sindhudurg was declared Maharashtra's first tourism district, leveraging its Konkan coast, forts, and heritage spots — not Kolhapur, Nashik, or Ratnagiri in the sequence given in the answer key.

subject: Geography
question: The dolomite deposits are in ______ districts of Maharashtra.
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Dolomite deposits in Maharashtra are mainly linked to Yavatmal and Ratnagiri districts — part of the state's mineral map MPSC often tests alongside limestone and manganese belts.

subject: Geography
question: Match the following : District - Taluka (a) Nanded - (i) Bhokar (b) Jalna - (ii) Bhokardan (c) Buldhana - (iii) Umerkhed (d) Yavatmal - (iv) Sangrampur
explanation: Match the pairs: Nanded–Bhokar, Jalna–Bhokardan, Buldhana–Sangrampur, Yavatmal–Umerkhed — option D. Lock one taluka you know (Bhokar in Nanded or Bhokardan in Jalna) and the rest fall into place.

subject: Geography
question: To which of the following district boundaries are connected to Jalna district? (a) Buldhana, Parbhani, Beed, Aurangabad (b) Buldhana, Washim, Parbhani, Nanded, Beed, Aurangabad, Jalgaon (c) Aurangabad, Jalgaon, Usmanabad, Parbhani, Hingoli, Buldhana Which of the following answer is correct ?

options.D: All the above statements are wrong

explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Jalna shares boundaries with Buldhana, Parbhani, Beed and Aurangabad — statement (a). Options (b) and (c) mix in districts like Washim, Nanded or Hingoli that do not border Jalna.

subject: General Studies
question: Since 1950-51 to 2013-14 the share of agriculture sector in total gross domestic product indicating ________ trends.
explanation: The right pick is option B. From 1950-51 to 2013-14 the agriculture sector's share in India's total GDP shows a clear declining trend — industry and services grew faster even when farm output rose.

subject: General Studies
question: Konkan division of Maharashtra has a sustainable comparative advantage in the following sectors. (a) Agriculture and Agro Processing Industries (b) Forests and Mineral Wealth (c) Textile Industry (d) Fisheries, horticulture, tourism Which of the above statement is/are true ?
explanation: On this one, option C. Konkan's sustainable comparative advantage in this paper is fisheries, horticulture and tourism — the coast, heavy rainfall and ports suit these sectors more than inland textile or broad agro-processing alone.

subject: Economy
question: According to the Maharashtra Government's Budget Estimate for 2016-17, which of the following is the correct sequence of the relative shares of revenue sources as per their importance in the total revenue ? (a) State Excise Duties, Sales Tax, Other Taxes (b) Tax and Duties on Electricity, State Excise Duties, Tax on Vehicles (c) Sales Tax, Stamps and Registration charges, State Excise Duties (d) Stamps and Registration charges, State Excise Duties, Other Taxes Which of the above statement/s is/are correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Maharashtra's 2016-17 budget ranked revenue sources with Sales Tax first, then Stamps and Registration charges, then State Excise — only statement (c) matches that descending order.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following states adopted Fiscal Responsibility Legislation even before the Central Government ? (a) Uttar Pradesh, Punjab (b) Karnataka, Kerala (c) Tamil Nadu (d) West Bengal Which of the following answer is correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Several states enacted Fiscal Responsibility Legislation before the Centre — Uttar Pradesh and Punjab (a), Karnataka and Kerala (b), and Tamil Nadu (c); West Bengal alone (d) is too narrow.

subject: Reasoning
question: One of the following alternatives shows : the cost of generating one day of employment (₹) and average employment per household (days) respectively for the year 2015-16 related to the MGNREGA Scheme for the State of Maharashtra. Which one of the below statement is correct ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. For Maharashtra under MGNREGA in 2015-16 the official figures are ₹242 per person-day of employment generated and about 60 average employment days per household — exam-specific data, not a rounded textbook figure.

subject: Economy
question: The average GDP growth rate during the later phases of planning 1981 to 2012 was ________
explanation: The right pick is option B. Average GDP growth during the later planning phase from 1981 to 2012 is given as 5.9% — the post-1980 reform era when growth picked up above the earlier 'Hindu rate' but below today's peaks.

subject: General Studies
question: 'Universal Basic Income' has following components : (1) universality (2) unconditionality (3) agency (respect for recipient's choice) (4) all of the above
explanation: On this one, option D. Universal Basic Income combines universality (everyone covered), unconditionality (no strings attached) and agency (recipients choose how to spend) — all three pillars, not any single component alone.

subject: Economy
question: Match the following : List - I (Fiscal Indicators) - List - II (Budget Estimates (2018-19) as % of GDP) (a) Fiscal Deficit - (i) 12.1 (b) Revenue Deficit - (ii) 48.8 (c) Total Outstanding Liabilities - (iii) 2.2 (d) Gross Tax Revenue as percentage of GDP - (iv) 3.3
explanation: Pick option C. For Union Budget 2018-19 estimates: Fiscal Deficit 3.3% of GDP, Revenue Deficit 2.2%, Total Outstanding Liabilities 48.8%, Gross Tax Revenue 12.1% — pair a–iv, b–iii, c–ii, d–i.

subject: General Studies
question: According to the theory of demographic transition in the second stage there is ____________ .

options.B: population remains more or less stable
options.C: rate of population growth remains stable

explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. In demographic transition theory, stage II sees death rates fall while birth rates stay high — so the population grows rapidly before fertility also declines in stage III.

subject: General Studies
question: According the Government of Maharashtra 2013 Kelkar Committee Report Publication, following communities from Maharashtra are enumerated as Primitive Tribal Groups. (a) Katkaris (b) Madia Gonds (c) Kolams (d) Bhils One of the following alternatives is correct.
explanation: Go with option A. Per the 2013 Kelkar Committee report cited here, Katkaris, Madia Gonds and Kolams are listed among Maharashtra's Primitive Tribal Groups — Bhils are a major ST but not in this PTG set for the key.

subject: General Studies
question: According to results of PSE's in 2004-05, PSEs show much better results in new economic environment due to.

options.B: Reduction of bureaucratic and political control

explanation: Go with option D. PSEs performed better in the post-reform period when given greater autonomy, freed from heavy bureaucratic and political control, and pushed toward a more private-sector culture — the key treats all three as joint reasons.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following are the objectives of economic planning for the agricultural sector ?

options.C: reduce inequality of incomes in rural area

explanation: Pick option D. Economic planning for agriculture aims to raise farm output, expand rural jobs and narrow income inequality in villages — every option listed is a stated objective, so 'all the above' fits.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following : List - I (Government Scheme) - List - II (Objective) (a) Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana - (i) to provide LPG connections to BPL households (b) Saubhagya Scheme - (ii) to enhance financial health of electricity distribution companies (c) Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana - (iii) universal household electrification (d) The Ujjawal Discom Assurance Yojana - (iv) to develop and refinance micro industrial activities
explanation: Match the pairs: Mudra–micro enterprise refinance (iv), Saubhagya–universal household electrification (iii), Ujjwala–LPG to BPL families (i), UDAY–discom financial health (ii) — option C. Do not swap Ujjwala with Saubhagya; one is LPG, the other is power connection.

subject: General Studies
question: The monetary policy refers to a regulatory policy where the Central bank maintains its control over the _______.
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Monetary policy is the RBI's regulation of money supply — through repo rate, CRR, SLR and open-market operations — not direct control of public expenditure or tax revenue (those are fiscal tools).

subject: General Studies
question: If deprivation score is _______ percent or greater, that household is multidimensionally poor.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. In the Multidimensional Poverty Index, a household is counted poor when its weighted deprivation score reaches one-third (33.33%) or more across the chosen indicators.

subject: General Studies
question: Find the heat generated in calories if a current of 0.3A is passed through a coil of resistance 418Ω for one minute.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Heat H = I²Rt = (0.3)² × 418 × 60 = 2257.2 J; dividing by 4.184 J/cal gives about 540 calories — re-check the minute-to-second conversion if your count lands elsewhere.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following : (a) C.V. Raman - (i) Magnetism due to electric current (b) George Ohm - (ii) Electric Motor (c) Hans Oersted - (iii) Scattering of light (d) Michael Faraday - (iv) Resistance in an electric circuit (v) Electric current
explanation: Match the pairs: Raman–light scattering (iii), Ohm–resistance (iv), Oersted–magnetism from current (i), Faraday–electric motor (ii) — option B. Ohm maps to (iv), not (v); Oersted to (i), not the motor.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statements is correct according to the laws of reflections for drawing ray diagrams of a concave mirror ? (A) If the incident ray is parallel to the principal axis then the reflected ray passes through the focus. (B) If the incident ray is passing through the focus then the reflected ray is parallel to the principal axis. Select the correct option :

options.B: Statement (A) is correct and (B) is wrong.
options.C: Statement (A) is wrong and (B) is correct.

explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. For a concave mirror, both standard ray rules hold: a ray parallel to the principal axis reflects through the focus, and a ray through the focus reflects parallel to the axis — statements (A) and (B) together.

subject: General Studies
question: General formula of alkynes is _______
explanation: The right pick is option C. Alkynes carry a triple bond, so the general formula is CₙH₂ₙ₋₂ — one pair of hydrogens fewer than alkenes (CₙH₂ₙ) and two fewer than alkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂).

subject: General Studies
question: Match the columns : (a) Cryolite - (i) CuCO₃·Cu(OH)₂ (b) Magnetite - (ii) Al₂O₃·xH₂O (c) Malachite - (iii) ZnCO₃ (d) Sphalerite - (iv) Fe₃O₄ (v) Fe₂O₃ (vi) CuFeS₂ (vii) Na₃AlF₆ (viii) ZnS
explanation: On this one, option B. Cryolite is Na₃AlF₆ (vii), magnetite Fe₃O₄ (iv), malachite CuCO₃·Cu(OH)₂ (i), sphalite ZnS (viii) — lock cryolite and malachite first; the copper and zinc ores then pair cleanly.

subject: General Studies
question: Brunner's gland occurs in :
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Brunner's glands sit in the submucosa of the duodenum and secrete alkaline mucus to neutralise acidic chyme — not in the stomach, oesophagus or ileum.

subject: General Studies
question: Select correct answer. Peptide chain termination occurs with which codons ? (a) UAA, UGA, UGC (b) UAG, CGA, AGC (c) UGA, UAA, UAG (d) CGA, UAA, UGA
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. The three stop codons that end peptide-chain synthesis are UAA, UAG and UGA — only list (c). UGC codes for cysteine; the other mixes are random triplets, not terminators.

subject: General Studies
question: The Discoverer of electron is :
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. J.J. Thomson identified the electron in cathode-ray experiments — the first subatomic particle to be discovered. Goldstein found canal rays (protons), Chadwick the neutron, and Rutherford mapped the nuclear atom.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the statements given below is/are correct ? (a) Taenia solium is called as Hookworm. (b) Fasciola hepatica is commonly known as liver fluke. (c) Ancylostoma duodenale is also called as Tapeworm. (d) Nereis chilkaensis is commonly called as Ragworm.
explanation: The right pick is option B. Fasciola hepatica is the liver fluke and Nereis chilkaensis is the ragworm — both correctly named. Taenia solium is a tapeworm (not hookworm), and Ancylostoma duodenale is the hookworm (not tapeworm).

subject: Reasoning
question: Which chromosomal characters play important role in classification of plants? (a) Number of chromosomes (b) Morphology of chromosomes (c) Size of chromosomes (d) Aberrations in chromosomes Which of the given above statement/s is/are correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Plant taxonomists weigh chromosome number, morphology, size and even aberrations — all four listed characters can separate or relate species and genera.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following plant groups has vascular system, produces spores, but does not has seed ?
explanation: On this one, option B. Pteridophytes have a vascular system and reproduce by spores but never form seeds — unlike bryophytes (no vascular tissue), gymnosperms and angiosperms (seed-bearing).

subject: Science
question: The plant disease "Late Blight of Potato" is caused by which of the following organism ?
explanation: Go with option A. Late blight of potato is the classic Irish-famine disease caused by the oomycete Phytophthora infestans. Pythium causes damping-off; Albugo causes white rust; Colletotrichum causes anthracnose.

subject: General Studies
question: The infections which usually develop slowly and are long-lasting are known as ______ infections.
explanation: Pick option A. Infections that develop slowly and persist for a long time are called chronic — tuberculosis and hepatitis B are textbook examples. Acute infections rise and resolve quickly; latency is a dormant phase, not the whole disease course.

subject: Science
question: Sensory nerve cells called Rods and Cones are found in ______.
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Rods and cones are the photoreceptor nerve cells packed in the retina — they convert light into neural signals. Cochlea handles hearing; dermis and epidermis are skin layers.

subject: General Studies
question: Find the value of Y and Z respectively after identifying the rule in number arrangement. [Diagram: four circles, each divided into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). Circle 1: 9, 4, 8, 3. Circle 2: 11, Z, 8, 3. Circle 3: 18, 10, 17, Y. Circle 4: 27, 10, 43, 26.]
explanation: The right pick is option D. In each circle, opposite quadrants add to the same total: 9+3=12 and 4+8=12; so Z=6 (11+3=6+8) and Y=9 (18+9=10+17); circle 4 checks as 27+26=10+43.

subject: General Studies
question: You are having 2 cubes X and Y in front of you that are placed adjacent to each other. Study the information about these cubes that is given below : Cube X is on your left side and cube Y is on your right side. One of the opposite faces pair of cube X is painted red. Another pair of opposite faces is painted blue and one of the remaining faces is painted yellow and other one is violate. Only one pair of opposite faces of cube Y is painted blue. Another pair of opposite faces has brown and green colour while remaining opposite pair has black and white colour. If red face of cube X and blue face of Y are touching table, yellow of X and brown of Y are facing you; then select the colour of face of cube Y that is facing blue side of cube X.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. With red (X) and blue (Y) on the table, yellow (X) and brown (Y) facing you, the lateral face of Y that meets X's blue side must be from the black–white pair — either black or white depending on orientation, not uniquely fixed.

subject: Reasoning
question: Identify the wrong term, in the given number series : 6, 24, 72, 240, 726
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. After 6×4=24 the series should run ×10/3, ×3, ×3 (→ 80, 240, 720); 72 breaks that chain — 24×3 gives 72 but the next multiplier to 240 expects 80, not 72.

subject: General Studies
question: Study the following information carefully and answer the question asked : Seven candidates Hari, Samir, Nilesh, Shailaja, Nikita, Laxman and Sujata are interviewed for selection as teacher by different panels I to VII for different school A, B, C, D, E, F and G not necessarily in the same order of schools and panels. Nilesh is interviewed by panel IV for school A. Samir is interviewed by panel III but not for school C or D. Hari is interviewed for school B, but not by panel I or II. Nikita is interviewed by panel VI for school E. Panel VII conducts the interview for school F. Shailaja is interviewed by panel I but not for school C. Panel II does not interviewed Laxman. Who was interviewed by Panel V ?
explanation: On this one, option A. Nilesh is Panel IV–School A and Nikita Panel VI–School E; Hari must be School B on a panel other than I or II — Samir holds III, so Hari sits on Panel V. Shailaja (I), Samir (III) and Panel VII (School F) fill the remaining slots.

subject: General Studies
question: Measurements of lizard like animal are as follows. Its head is 7 cm long. Its body length between the head and the tail is equal to the head plus tail. The tail length is equal to the head plus one half of the body length between the head and the tail. Select the option that indicates total length of the lizard.
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Let body = B and tail = T: B = 7+T and T = 7+B/2 gives B = 28 cm and T = 21 cm; total length = head 7 + body 28 + tail 21 = 56 cm.

subject: Geography
question: There are six routes for reaching from town A to hill town B. Three of these are indicated by P, Q and R and other three are indicated by 1, 2, and 3. Route Q is closed during stormy weather. Routes P, 1 and 3 are affected by flooding of one river. If route 1 is closed, route R gets closed automatically as both are bifurcations of the single route from A after some distance. Select the route/s which is/are available for transport when weather is stormy and causes flooding of the rivers that affect the routes.
explanation: Go with option C. Storm closes Q; flooding shuts P, 1 and 3; closing 1 also closes R — only route 2 stays open under both conditions.

subject: Reasoning
question: If the average of p and q is 20, the average of q and y is 25, the average of p, q and y is 23, then what is the average of p and y ?
explanation: Pick option A. p+q=40, q+y=50 and p+q+y=69 give y=29, q=21, p=19; average of p and y = (19+29)/2 = 24.

subject: General Studies
question: Which number will replace the question mark ? [Diagram: three circles with a number at the centre and four numbers around the perimeter (top, left, right, bottom). Circle 1: centre 91; top 7, left 5, right 4, bottom 1. Circle 2: centre 66; top 1, left 2, right 5, bottom 6. Circle 3: centre ?; top 2, left 3, right 4, bottom 4.]
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. The centre equals the sum of squares of the four outer numbers: 7²+5²+4²+1²=91, 1²+2²+5²+6²=66, and 2²+3²+4²+4²=45.

subject: General Studies
question: The relation between third and fourth number is same as it is in first two numbers. Select correct option in place of question mark. 86 : 29 :: 98 : ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Multiply the two digits and subtract a built-up term: 8×6−19=29 and 9×8−40=32 — the subtracted part scales with the digit pair, giving 32 for 98.

subject: General Studies
question: Accompanying image shows different areas that represent specific language speakers residing in one colony. Arrow - Marathi, Circle - Gujarati, Triangle - Kannada Rectangle - Hindi, Irregular - English. Select false conclusion/s based on this information. [Diagram: five overlapping shapes — upward arrow (Marathi), circle (Gujarati), upward triangle (Kannada), vertical rectangle (Hindi), irregular cloud-like shape (English) — with complex central intersections.] Conclusions : (a) Some persons do speak four languages but no one speaks all the five languages mentioned in the list. (b) Some persons speak Kannada and Hindi only. (c) Though some Marathi speaking persons do speak Gujarati but some of these speak Hindi also. (d) There are persons who speak Marathi and other two languages but some persons speak Marathi and Hindi only.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. From the overlapping language regions, some people speak four of the five languages but no region covers all five — only conclusion (a) holds; (b), (c) and (d) overstate exclusive or partial overlaps the diagram does not show.

subject: General Studies
question: There is some relationship between two terms at the left of :: and same relationship holds between two terms to the right. Find out the correct alternative, in place of question mark. EF : 15 :: KL : ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Letter positions multiply and halve: E(5)×F(6)/2=15, so K(11)×L(12)/2=66.

subject: General Studies
question: The relation between third and fourth term is as it is in first two terms. What Number should replace the question mark? 122 : 170 :: 290 : ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. 122+48=170 where 48=(1+2)×16; 290+72=362 where 72=(2+9)×8 — the increment uses the first two digits, scaled down when the last digit is 0.

subject: General Studies
question: In a certain code language, if VIDEO is coded as VWREL and CHAIR is coded as RZSXI then how will BOARD be coded in that code language?
explanation: On this one, option B. BOARD encodes to IZLYW by the same position-wise letter-shift pattern used for VIDEO→VWREL and CHAIR→RZSXI — trace each letter through the code rather than guessing one global rule.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements : (a) Kunda is available at home during 12 noon to 4 pm on Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday. (b) Her younger sister Naina is available at home on Monday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday during 10 am to 2 pm. (c) The eldest sister Jyoti is available at home during 9 am to 12 noon on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday and 2 pm to 4 pm on Friday, Saturday and Sunday. On which day and at what time, all the three sisters are available at home ?
explanation: Go with option B. On Thursday, Kunda (12–4), Naina (10–2) and Jyoti (9–12) coincide only at 12 noon; on Sunday, Kunda (12–4) and Jyoti (2–4) overlap at 2 pm while Naina is still available until 2 pm — both slots work.

subject: Reasoning
question: Study following information about the joint family comprised of three generations. A, B, C, D, E and F are members with two married couples and each member prefers distinct fruit amongst banana, chiku, pineapple, figs, guava and orange. None of the male member prefers either figs or guava. C, who is daughter in law of E, enjoys pineapple most. B, who is unmarried son of D, prefers chiku. F is a grandchild of A, adopted by 2nd generation couple and F does not like orange. Person A prefers figs and has a spouse who prefers banana. Select statements from following set which are not true with respect to this information. Statements : (a) D prefers orange and is not a son of A. (b) E is definitely a male member of the family. (c) C has adopted a girl.
explanation: Pick option B. Only statement (a) is not true: tracing the fruit clues and generations shows D does prefer orange but is actually A's son — the rest of the family grid stands. Statements (b) and (c) hold once you have placed C as E's daughter-in-law and F as the adopted grandchild — (b) E is male and (c) C adopted a girl.

subject: Science
question: 'प्रधानमंत्री मातृत्व (मातृ) वंदना' योजनेबाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या : (a) सदरहू योजना 1 एप्रिल 2016 रोजी केंद्र शासनाने लागू केली आहे. (b) या योजनेनुसार शासन गर्भवती आणि स्तनदा मातांना ₹ 8,000 वित्त सहाय्य देते. (c) गर्भवती महिलांना आणि स्तनदा मातांना रोख रकमेद्वारे त्यांचे आरोग्य सुधारणे हे देखील या योजनेचे उद्दिष्ट आहे.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. फक्त विधान (c) बरोबर आहे — PMMVY मध्ये रोख प्रोत्साहनांद्वारे गर्भवती व स्तनपान करणाऱ्या मातांना पोषण व ante-natal care सुधारण्याचा उद्देश. (a) सुरुवातीची तारीख चुकी आहे — 2017, 1 April 2016 नाही; (b) ₹8,000 ऐवजी ₹5,000 हप्त्यांत.
